beats.say: Your video went viral. So why is it still zero dollars?
Views aren't what pays you first. Fans are.

Fan money starts much earlier. Spotify Memberships open at [100|one hundred] listeners. YouTube fan funding at [500|five hundred] subscribers. Ad money needs [1,000|one thousand] subscribers and [10,000,000|ten million] Shorts views.
The catch: fans need a reason to pay, like bonus episodes or live chats, and each program has its own country and review rules.
Comment GUIDE for the free guide, or try the free AI income finder on [subcreatorpaid.com|sub creator paid dot com]. Tools I use are in my bio. Follow for more.
